atAGlance: Mì Quảng gà is a Quảng Nam-style chicken noodle bowl with wide turmeric rice noodles, shallow chicken broth, herbs, peanuts, and a crisp rice cracker. It is a central-Vietnam dish, not a soup.
whatItIs: Mì Quảng gà is a central-Vietnam noodle bowl with wide turmeric rice noodles, chicken, herbs, peanuts, rice cracker, and shallow broth. It should look half-dry compared with soup.
howToEnjoy: Break some rice cracker into the bowl, mix the shallow broth through the noodles, then add lime or chili. Do not expect the broth to cover everything.
howLocalsOrder: Mì Quảng gà should arrive with turmeric rice noodles, peanuts, herbs, and only a shallow amount of broth. Ask for extra broth if you prefer it wetter, and ask for no peanuts before the bowl is built.
worthKnowing: Mì Quảng is associated with Quảng Nam and central Vietnam. Its shallow broth, turmeric noodles, herbs, peanuts, and rice cracker are the signature.
goodToKnow: The broth is intentionally shallow and concentrated. Mix before adding lime or chili so the turmeric broth coats the noodles.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì Quảng gà.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of quảng-style turmeric noodles with chicken.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht toh mee kwahng gah
